name: Chicken-Rice "Paella" Bake with Bell Pepper, Asparagus & Artichoke

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 yellow bell peppers
3 small bunches asparagus
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 ½ lemons

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus; cut spears into 1-inch pieces. Place both in a large bowl.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl with the bell pepper and asparagus; set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.36 kg chicken thighs, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; working in batches if necessary, add chicken and cook until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Once golden, transfer to a clean plate (the chicken will not be cooked all the way through). Reserve skillet with juices for later use.
Meanwhile, using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain.
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and rice; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies start to soften, about 3 minutes.

Once the veggies are soft, add broth, tomato sauce, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a boil. Once boiling, transfer mixture to a large baking dish and add chicken (and any accumulated juices), nestling chicken into the veggies and rice. Cover with an ovenproof lid or foil.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
3 (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
2 tbsp paprika
1 tbsp oregano, dried
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp coriander, ground
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking dish in the oven and bake until rice has fully absorbed liquid and chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and roughly chop artichoke hearts.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the chicken and rice are done, add artichokes and half of the parsley to the baking dish; stir to combine the "paella." (Reserve remaining parsley for garnish.)
To serve, divide paella between plates or bowls; sprinkle with reserved parsley and squeeze lemon over top. Enjoy!
